With agent groups, you can organize and manage the agents linked to your Tenable Vulnerability
Management account. Use the API to add an agent to more than one agent group, and configure
scans to use agent groups as targets.
For more information about agent groups, see Agent Groups in the Tenable Vulnerability
Management User Guide.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
